About the Cheyenne Mountain Bike Club Wednesday Social Ride group ride

A Wednesday evening social mountain bike ride at Curt Gowdy State Park, west of Cheyenne. Riders meet at Aspen Grove and head out from there. The club's site has not been updated much lately, so confirm the ride is on before driving out.
